subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Telecom and Internet Backbone
description: A quick, practical guide to Telecom and Internet Backbone.

hook.text: China's Salt Typhoon hackers infiltrated US telecom networks and accessed wiretap systems meant for law enforcement.

buildup.text: Telecom networks carry everything — calls, texts, financial transactions, government communications.

discovery.text: BGP hijacking can reroute internet traffic through hostile countries without anyone noticing for hours.

twist.text: The tools built to enable lawful wiretapping become the exact tools attackers want to compromise.

climax.text: Telecom infrastructure is the invisible backbone. Compromise it and you compromise everything built on top.

punchline.text: Hack the backbone. See everything. Hear everything.

quiz.question: What did the Salt Typhoon hackers access?
options: US telecom wiretap systems for law enforcement
